data.name: Usage
data.value:
Usage: EarPair.Sender <Mac IP address> [options]
--port N UDP port of the Mac receiver (default 47800) --device NAME Output device to capture; any part of its name works (default: the system default output device) --list-devices List all output devices --frames N Frames per packet (default 240, which is 5 ms at 48 kHz; at most 360) --no-keepalive Don't play silence to keep capture going (when Windows is silent, sending stops and the Mac shows Disconnected) -h, --help Show help
Example: EarPair.Sender 192.168.1.20
data.comment: 选项名（--port 等）和示例不翻译；说明对齐到第 19 列

data.name: MustBeInteger
data.value: {0} must be a whole number from {1} to {2}

data.name: HostMissing
data.value: Specify the Mac's local network IP address (EarPair shows it in the Mac menu bar).

data.name: DeviceNotFound
data.value: No output device has "{0}" in its name. Use --list-devices to see them all.

data.name: Standby
data.value: Standby: no sound, audio paused, handshake kept

data.name: SendingTo
data.value: Sending: {0} Hz stereo 16-bit → {1}:{2}, {3} frames per packet

data.name: MultichannelTip
data.value: Tip: This output device is multichannel and has been mixed down to stereo. For better results, set it to stereo in Windows Sound settings.

data.name: WaitingForDevice
data.value: Waiting for the output device… (continues automatically when it's back)

data.name: NoKeepAliveTip
data.value: Tip: Without the silent keepalive, sending stops when Windows is silent and the Mac shows Disconnected.

data.name: Progress
data.comment: {0}：已运行时间，{1}：包数，{2}：码率，{3}：发送失败次数
